patthana23.13:1.1: na kusalaṃ na hīnaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo hīnodhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.13:2.1: na kusalaṃ na majjhimaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato majjhimo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
patthana23.13:3.1: na kusalaṃ na paṇītaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo paṇīto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha. nakusalattika namicchattattike kusalattika micchattattikaṃ
